title: Automating Claude Code: Hooks, Subagents, MCP, Plugins, and CI

questions.prompt: Which exit code does a hook use to block an action?
questions.explanation: Exit 0 means no objection; exit 2 blocks the action, and what the hook writes to stderr becomes the reason.

questions.prompt: Match each hook event to when it fires.

pairs.right: Before a tool runs (can block it)
After a tool runs (for example, to format a file)
When Claude is waiting for your input or permission

questions.explanation: These lifecycle events let hooks block risky actions, post-process edits, alert you, or check work at the end of a turn.

questions.prompt: To share an MCP server with your whole team, add it with --scope project, which stores it in a committed ____ file.
questions.explanation: Project-scoped MCP servers live in .mcp.json at the project root, which you commit so teammates get the same tools.

questions.prompt: Which make an unattended claude -p run safer? Select all that apply.

options.text: --permission-mode dontAsk, which denies anything not pre-approved
Granting every tool so it never gets stuck

questions.explanation: Minimal allowlists, dontAsk mode, and caps keep unattended runs contained. Granting every tool removes the protection.

questions.prompt: A team writes "NEVER edit .env" in CLAUDE.md, but Claude edits .env.local anyway. What's the robust fix?

options.text: Add deny rules and a PreToolUse hook that exits 2 for those paths
Write the rule in capital letters three more times

questions.explanation: CLAUDE.md is advisory. Deny rules and PreToolUse hooks are enforced by Claude Code itself, so the action is blocked, not just discouraged.

questions.prompt: Order the quick setup of Claude in GitHub Actions.

items.text: Mention @claude in an issue or pull request
Merge the workflow pull request it prepares
Let it install the GitHub App and save the authentication secret

questions.explanation: /install-github-app installs the app, saves the secret, and opens a workflow PR. Once that PR is merged, @claude works in the repository.
